_doc: Per-print exceptions to the variation derived from a non-unique reference's product letter (B = standard, A = alt-art, P = promo). See index-core/src/variation_overrides.rs. Applied when the HTTP API loads the index: editing this file needs a rebuild of the API, not a re-index.
